abstract: DreamHost is a low-cost host that allows 25 sites on its cheapest plan. Launch is $2.89 a month on a 1-year term and renews at $10.99. There is no phone support.

citation.name: WPBeginner: Hostinger review with DreamHost comparison (10 Aug 2026)
web.dev: Largest Contentful Paint (2.5 seconds or less is good)

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for bloggers, small businesses and people with several small sites. Launch allows 25 websites with daily backups. The trade-offs are the renewal price, no phone support and speed that trails LiteSpeed hosts.
On DreamHost's pricing page on 20 November 2026, Launch was $2.89 a month on a 1-year term, Growth $3.99 and Scale $9.99. On a 4-year term Launch is $1.99. The full term is charged at checkout.

mainEntity.name: How much does DreamHost cost after renewal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Launch renews at $10.99 a month after a 1-year term, or $7.99 after a 4-year term. Growth renews at $12.99 or $8.99, and Scale at $25.99 or $19.99. A longer first term gives a lower renewal.

mainEntity.name: How many WordPress sites does DreamHost host?

acceptedAnswer.text: Launch allows 25 websites, Growth 50 and Scale 100. DreamPress, the managed WordPress plan, allows 1 site on DreamPress 1.

mainEntity.name: Can I use WordPress plugins on DreamHost shared hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. WPSchool ran WordPress with WooCommerce and seven plugins on a DreamHost shared test site for 30 days. Shared plans have no server-level cache, so a caching plugin helps.
The cheapest plan allows 25 sites with NVMe storage and daily backups, and DreamHost shows renewal prices up front. It also offers a free shared plan to eligible US nonprofits.

It is average. WPBeginner measured 986 ms Largest Contentful Paint and 658 ms average response in July 2026, behind Hostinger at 659 ms and 227 ms. Hosttest.de measured 0.133 s time to first byte on a Launch plan.

mainEntity.name: Does DreamHost have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 30 days on the current plan pages. Some older reviews say 97 days, but they describe plans DreamHost no longer sells to new customers.
No. Support is 24/7 live chat and tickets. WPRoom says a one-time callback costs $9.95.
Only for the first 3 months. Launch includes 20 mailboxes, Growth 40 and Scale 60 in the trial. After that, email costs from $1.67 a month per mailbox on annual billing, according to WPRoom.

mainEntity.name: Does DreamHost offer free nonprofit hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: DreamHost's help article, as summarized by TechEMPOWER in May 2026, offers one free shared plan to US 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(19) nonprofits, plus 35% off DreamPress. The IRS determination letter is the only proof accepted. Check DreamHost for current terms.

mainEntity.name: Does DreamHost have staging and a CDN?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not on the shared plans. DreamHost says you need DreamPress for Bunny CDN and one-click staging.
DreamHost allows more sites on its entry plan (25 against 10). In WPBeginner's July 2026 tests it loaded in 986 ms against 933 ms for Bluehost. Bluehost offers phone support on higher plans.
